answer.rationale: low-cost vendor quote alone clears the 18% mandate; c2 confirms their onboarding and invoicing were reliable, supporting a switch. the line at 94% with no buffer makes deferral unsafe and renewal at current price fails the mandate without negotiation. c4 shows renegotiation can recover margin, so any future dual-sourcing step (next cycle) can fall back to negotiating the incumbent from a position of having a qualified second source. c6 notes multi-year deals cut unit cost, so if the pilot performs, locking longer term with the low-cost vendor later preserves savings. final answer: switch primary to the low-cost vendor, phased cutover or parallel-run to protect the 94% throughput.
